LESSON: MIXTURES

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY
Strand: Matter
Topic 2.1: Mixtures

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Mixtures. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Mixtures
2. Practise Mixtures at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Mixtures

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Mixtures
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Mixtures. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Mixtures at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Mixtures at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Mixtures
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Mixtures. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Mixtures using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Mixtures in the examples.
2. Explain Mixtures to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Mixtures.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Mixtures using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Mixtures important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Mixtures
2. Practise Mixtures at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Mixtures

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
